_readme: Supporter interest (2026-11-10, supporter.go). interest: someone who wants to WORK as a supporter — by: 'rule' (SupporterInterest matches) or 'model' (no rule; the classifier must say supporter_interest). errand: near-misses that ARE errands or customer questions — no rule may match, and the classifier must not say supporter_interest. follow_up: sent after the application link went out — the follow-up line by rule. after_link_errand: after the link, still an errand. mixed: an errand plus interest — rest is the errand words the router keeps. Run by go test (rules, router) and agenttest -supporter (rules, then LLM_SMALL_MODEL).
